title: 第13章 柳姨的危机第14章 天海商会
lines: 夜幕降临。
唐明和苏雨柔并排走着，在橘黄色路灯照耀下，颇有种微妙的意境，就像情侣一般。
很快，两人来到了城南一栋商业小区。
唐明停下脚步，扭头笑道：“时间不早了，你先进去吧。”
苏雨柔俏脸有些发烫，这还是第一次有男生主动送她回家，难免有些遐想。
“走了，拜拜。”
唐明挥挥手，然后独自离去。
不多时，他回到陈家，只是让他意外的是，陈思琪在门外阶梯上坐着，屋内还传来不少人说话的声音。
门口还停着几辆奥迪轿车。
陈思琪看到唐明，有些意外：“咦，今天樊晨那些人没找你麻烦吗？”
她看到唐明身上没有半点伤势。
今下午她也在校门口，准备让赵鹏出手，然后警察来了就没怎么管，按理说警察过来的时间比较晚，唐明应该被许杰樊晨教训了一顿。
可他身上，丝毫不像是挨揍的模样。
唐明没回答这个问题，指着门口道：“屋内怎么了，有人闹事吗？”
“不知道，他们是我妈公司的人。”
陈思琪愁眉苦脸：“好像是我妈负责的项目出了意外，公司高层过来问责。”
“你爸呢？”
“我爸还在路上往回赶，但估计还要一个小时才到家……”
正说着，屋内突然传来玻璃杯摔碎的脆响，伴随着柳姨歇斯底里的怒喊。
嗯？
唐明面色顿时冷厉，直接推开门冲进去。
客厅里，有五名穿着西装打着领带的中年男子，其中一个男子被茶水泼了一身，地上是摔碎的玻璃杯。
柳姨满脸怒火，指着一名男子怒道：“史学坤，你敢陷害我？”
“柳晴，你别给脸不要脸。”
史学坤拿衣袖擦拭茶水，不怒反笑：“产品研发这个项目是你负责的，李媛也是你心腹手下，如今她捐款逃匿，你要负全责。”
“再说了，我们已经查明，项目合同上是你签名，那两千万资金也确实经过了你的账户转账，银行都有记录”
他指着桌上的合同冷笑：“看到了吗？有这些铁证在，你赖不掉！”
“你们这是联合起来给我挖坑！”
柳姨紧咬贝齿：“当初银行下班，说好资金只是暂时存留在我这，第二天我已经把钱打回去了。”
史学坤淡笑一声：“呵呵，你有证据吗？有录音文件或者正式合同吗？”
柳姨惨然一笑，神色黯淡下来。
她没有证据。
自始至终，她都是别人的棋子，本以为产品研发项目经理，会是一个很好发展的前途职位，却不想只是个替罪羔羊。
两千万资金的窟窿，全部要她赔偿！
柳姨越想越气：“这钱我不会出的，我根本没做过任何亏心事。”
“柳女士，我们是律师事务所的，根据南科集团法务部规定，你已经涉嫌商业诈骗犯罪行为。”
“十五日内，你要是不把两千万补偿回来，我们会启动司法程序，届时，你的车子、房屋等个人资产被银行没收，还会受到刑事处罚。”
一名律师淡淡开口，并且把相关的文件递过来。
什么？
柳姨面色剧变，看向史学坤咬牙切齿：“王八蛋，你这是要逼我走上绝路！”
“你这话可不对了，明明是你工作失误怎么还怪我呢？”
史学坤贪婪的盯着柳姨，舔舔嘴唇：“柳晴，我可以多给你宽松两个月，甚至免除你的牢狱之灾也行，但有个条件。”
content_en:
Night falls.
Tang Ming and Su Yurou were walking side by side. Under the illumination of the orange street lights, they had a subtle artistic conception, just like lovers.
Soon, the two came to a commercial complex in the south of the city.
Tang Ming stopped, turned around and smiled: "It's getting late, you go in first."
"Well..."
Su Yurou's pretty face felt a little hot. This was the first time a boy took the initiative to send her home, and it was inevitable that she would have some reverie.
"Let's go, bye."
Tang Ming waved his hand and left alone.
Not long after, he returned to Chen's house, but what surprised him was that Chen Siqi was sitting on the steps outside the door, and the sounds of many people talking could be heard in the house.
There are several Audi cars parked at the door.
Chen Siqi was a little surprised when she saw Tang Ming: "Hey, didn't Fan Chen and those people give you trouble today?"
She saw that Tang Ming had no injuries at all.
She was also at the school gate this afternoon, preparing for Zhao Peng to take action, but then the police came and ignored her. Logically speaking, the police came relatively late, so Tang Ming should have been taught a lesson by Xu Jie and Fan Chen.
But he didn't look like he had been beaten at all.
Tang Ming did not answer the question. He pointed to the door and said, "What's going on in the house? Is someone making trouble?"
"I don't know, they are from my mother's company."
Chen Siqi frowned: "It seems that something happened to the project my mother was responsible for, and the company's senior management came to hold me accountable."
"Where's your dad?"
"My dad is still on his way back, but it will probably take another hour before he gets home..."
Just as he was talking, there was a sudden sound of shattering glass in the room, accompanied by Aunt Liu's hysterical shouting.
Um?
Tang Ming's expression turned cold and stern, and he opened the door and rushed in.
In the living room, there were five middle-aged men wearing suits and ties. One of the men had tea poured all over him, and there was a broken glass on the floor.
Aunt Liu's face was full of anger, she pointed at a man and said angrily: "Shi Xuekun, do you dare to frame me?"
"Liu Qing, don't be so shameless."
Shi Xuekun wiped the tea with his sleeves and smiled instead of being angry: "You are responsible for the product research and development project, and Li Yuan is also your confidant. Now that she has donated money and escaped, you must take full responsibility."
"Besides, we have found out that it was your signature on the project contract, and the 20 million funds were indeed transferred through your account, and the bank has records."
He pointed at the contract on the table and sneered: "Did you see it? With these irrefutable evidence, you can't rely on it!"
"You are uniting to dig a hole for me!"
Aunt Liu gritted her teeth: "When the bank was closed, it was promised that the funds would only be temporarily deposited with me. The next day I had already sent the money back."
Shi Xuekun smiled lightly: "Haha, do you have evidence? Is there a recording file or a formal contract?"
"I..."
Aunt Liu smiled miserably and her expression darkened.
She has no evidence.
From the beginning to the end, she was someone else's pawn. She thought that product development project manager would be a promising position, but she didn't want to be just a scapegoat.
She needs to compensate for all the 20 million hole in the fund!
The more Aunt Liu thought about it, the angrier she became: "I won't pay this money. I haven't done anything wrong at all."
"Ms. Liu, we are from a law firm. According to the regulations of the Legal Department of Nanke Group, you have been suspected of commercial fraud."
"If you don't pay back the 20 million yuan in compensation within 15 days, we will initiate judicial proceedings. At that time, your car, house and other personal assets will be confiscated by the bank, and you will also be subject to criminal penalties."
A lawyer spoke calmly and handed over the relevant documents.
What?
Aunt Liu's face changed drastically, she looked at Shi Xuekun and gritted her teeth: "You bastard, you are trying to force me to go to a dead end!"
"What you said is wrong. It's obviously your fault at work. Why do you still blame me?"
Shi Xuekun stared at Aunt Liu greedily and licked his lips: "Liu Qing, I can give you two more months of relaxation, or even exempt you from prison, but there is a condition."
title_en: Chapter 13 Aunt Liu’s Crisis Chapter 14 Tianhai Chamber of Commerce
